visual_action: A short slideshow of two still photos of Ben Ray Luján. The first is an outdoor portrait, the second shows him in an office setting. Text is overlaid on the first image.

cast.name: Ben Ray Luján
cast.evidence: His name appears in the on-screen text "BEN RAY LUJÁN WINS NEW MEXICO DEMOCRATIC PRIMARY FOR U.S. SENATE" and his photos are the only visual content.

on_screen_text.text: MIDTERM NEWS BEN RAY LUJÁN WINS NEW MEXICO DEMOCRATIC PRIMARY FOR U.S. SENATE

audio_music: A high-energy, upbeat electronic/hip-hop track plays throughout the video, creating a celebratory and hype-filled mood.

intended_effect: To celebrate Ben Ray Luján's primary victory and generate excitement for his campaign.
